properties.name: idempotency.default-ttl
properties.description: How long a completed record stays replayable before the key can be reused. This is the deduplication window; make it at least as long as the slowest client retries for.

properties.name: idempotency.default-lease
properties.description: How long an acquisition is protected before another caller may steal it. The heartbeat extends it at half this interval, so it is also how long a crashed holder blocks the key.

properties.name: idempotency.default-wait
properties.description: How long a second caller blocks waiting for an in-flight key before being told to come back later. Zero means do not block, which is what a message listener wants.

properties.name: idempotency.completion-mode
properties.description: Whether an operation that does not choose for itself records its completion on its own (autonomous) or inside the transaction it is already running in (join-transaction). Joined completion requires a store whose supportsTransactionalCompletion() is true - JDBC yes, in-memory and Redis no.

properties.name: idempotency.completion-failure-policy
properties.description: What happens when the action succeeded but the store refused the completion. log-and-return logs the failure and returns the result anyway, losing the guarantee for that one key; propagate rethrows and the caller sees the storage error.

properties.name: idempotency.store-type
properties.description: Which store the starter builds. auto detects a JDBC store from the provider plus a single DataSource; jdbc and in-memory demand that backend and fail at startup if it cannot be built; none builds nothing. A store bean the application declares itself always wins.

properties.name: idempotency.jdbc.initialize-schema
properties.description: Whether the starter creates the idempotency_records table on startup. embedded creates it only on an embedded database, so a real one never gets DDL from a library; use the idempotency-schema-postgresql.sql or idempotency-schema-mysql.sql shipped in the provider jar instead.

properties.name: idempotency.web.key-header
properties.description: HTTP header carrying the idempotency key.

properties.name: idempotency.web.required
properties.description: Whether a request to an idempotent endpoint that carries no key is rejected with 422. One answer for the whole API rather than a per-endpoint one; false lets unkeyed requests through unprotected.

properties.name: idempotency.web.in-flight-status
properties.description: Status returned when another caller holds the key and did not finish within the wait timeout. The response carries Retry-After in whole seconds.

properties.name: idempotency.web.max-body-bytes
properties.description: Largest request body the filter will buffer for fingerprinting. A request over the limit receives HTTP 413. Set to -1 to disable the limit.

properties.name: idempotency.web.filter-order
properties.description: Order of the idempotency servlet filter. Lower values execute earlier; the default runs it after Spring Security.

properties.name: idempotency.purge.enabled
properties.description: Whether expired records are deleted on a schedule. Requires @EnableScheduling on the application.

properties.name: idempotency.purge.cron
properties.description: Cron expression controlling how often expired records are purged.
